verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's Query Assistant translates natural-language questions into queries (AI-assisted analysis) and its MCP integration explicitly lets an AI agent 'investigate and diagnose latency or error spikes' and 'identify performance outliers and suggest optimization opportunities' using live Honeycomb data. However, the deeper insight/suggestion generation is delivered via an external MCP-connected agent rather than a fully native, always-on in-product AI insights panel, and BubbleUp (outlier detection) is mentioned only in pricing without AI framing. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in AI-generated insights/summary feature independent of MCP agents, and independent/hands-on validation of suggestion quality.
